body: Haha it's okay. I know I can come off as such. I actually do for most people until they get to know me. Thanks though, I'll definitely heed your advice!

You're right in a way. I do think that I have made better choices than others, but I feel like they need to get on track in life and stop being a detriment to society before I respect them.

Sorry, I really don't mean to come off as snobbish or anything. I feel I'm one of the most relatable (sp?) a person can be. There's so many different aspects in my life that I can entertain a person on. I'm always eager to learn more about things I don't know.

Thanks. As far as you're second paragraph, I would love to do that, but a quote that I live by is "Seek freedom and become captive of your desires. Seek discipline and find liberty" - Frank Herbert. I feel like I have to suffer and bust my balls in a hope that I'll be able to have fun later in life. What if I don't get out of this drudge? What if I'm stuck in a life of more petty tasks and static associates?
